goal: Hub monitors every human and every bot, and is the bridge medium between them.

alreadyWorks.hub_sync: inbox + unfinished directives. every 60s while active.
alreadyWorks.work_report: buildingUid + taskId + activity + working|blocked|done + artifacts. every 60s. animation expires 2m.
alreadyWorks.ping: queues inbox. live viewers see it. externalWake is FALSE
alreadyWorks.bridgeStation: efficiency-guide Boardwide Brain Bridge — route jobs across Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok

broken: Pings do not wake Grok.com / Claude / Cursor sessions (A67-B005). Receipt is not acceptance.

Seats that stop heartbeating look empty, not honestly stale
No durable per-actor timeline. Radio is a chat, not a ledger of work.
Humans (Zeref) and bots are not the same row in one roster
Twins + ChatGPT stay dark. Assigned != online != connected
No trace id across a job that hops Heavy -> Cursor -> Claude -> live
researchUsed: Microsoft multi-agent observability: track actions, tool use, message flow, failures — not just presence chips
agent-ops-dashboard: register + heartbeat TTL 60s + activity feed with replay
agent-comm-hub: online = live SSE OR heartbeat < 90s. Tasks have a state machine.
agent-coherence: leases expire, fail closed, never silently serve stale as live

model.monitor: one board that lists every actor row. Stale is visible. Do not fake online.
model.bridge: radio + Brain Bridge + MCP seats. Authority is a directive with receipts. Chat is not a command.
